Per HUD's directive, all Site Condos must be on the 1073 form.

column2: FHA Case # must be located in the upper right hand corner and located on all pages of the report. CASE # MUST BE REPORTED IN THIS FORMAT: XXX-XXXXXXX. 10 NUMBERS TOTAL AND A DASH BETWEEN. THIS IS REQUIRED BY FHA.

The appraiser MUST include BOTH BELOW STATEMENTS. EXAMPLE: The INTENDED USER of this appraisal report is the Lender/Client and HUD/FHA. The Intended Use is to evaluate the property that is the subject of this appraisal for a mortgage finance transaction, subject to the stated Scope of Work, purpose of the appraisal, reporting requirements of this appraisal report form, and Definition of Market Value. No additional Intended Users are identified by the appraiser. EXAMPLE FOR INTENDED USE: The INTENDED USE of the appraisal is solely to assist FHA in assessing the risk of the property securing the FHA-insured mortgage (24 CFR 200.145(b)).

Include the statement noting if the subject meets FHA Minimum Property Requirements per HUD Handbook 4000.1 or if “subject to” include property will meet FHA Minimum Property Requirements upon completion of the subject to repairs.
Comparable sales 1, 2 and 3 MUST be within 12 months of the effective date.

If the property is in need of repair(s) which surpass the typically deemed cosmetic repair(s), alteration(s) or inspection conditions, complete the appraisal “subject to”. Note such repair(s), alteration(s) or inspection conditions. This includes making water, furnace, electrical and mechanics operational if they were not at the time of inspection. Please provide cost to cure for these items.

column1: IF Primary Heat source is a Space Heater
column2: When the primary heat source for the home is a space heater, verify and clearly state that the subject’s heat source is permanently affixed to the house. Also, verify and indicate that it can heat and maintain a temperature of at least 50 degrees Fahrenheit in all living spaces and those spaces with plumbing, and/or is acceptable to the local jurisdictional authority.

column1: IF there are security Bars on the windows
column2: For properties with security bars on windows, clearly state that at least one window in every bedroom has security bars with quick-release latches to allow for emergency exit.
All sides of the subject must be provided, Front, Rear, Street.

column1: Estimated Remaining Economic Life for FHA
column2: Estimated Remaining Economic Life must be given for all single-family, multi-family and condominiums. If the Estimated Remaining Economic Life is less than 30 years on FHA loans, please clearly explain why the subject does not meet the FHA minimum of 30 years remaining economic life.
Attic/Crawl: An inspection/viewing of the subject’s attic and crawl space are required, as well as a comment stating you made a Head and Shoulders inspection of the attic and crawl.

If the subject property being appraised includes multiple parcels, be sure to properly analyze them based on guidance in HUD 4000.1 to determine and report the existence of excess or surplus land. Commentary if land is excess or surplus is required in the report. The appraiser must include surplus land in the valuation. Excess land should not be included in the valuation.

column1: Well and Septic Requirements for FHA
column2: Appraiser must comment if Public Water and/or Sewer is available for hookup. If public water and/or sewer hookup is available, please provide cost to hookup.

column1: Well and Septic DISTANCE Requirements for FHA
column2: Provide commentary on the distance between the private well and septic. The well must be at least 50 ft. from septic tank, 100 ft. from septic drain field, and 10 ft. from property lines. Commentary needs to be specific to the FHA 4000.1 distance requirements.
